package.author: Tanumay Goswami
package.description: A download manager that fetches each file over many connections at once, with streaming video and torrents built in.

en-US.author: Tanumay Goswami
en-US.description: A download manager that fetches each file over many connections at once, with streaming video and torrents built in.
en-US.longDescription:
HyperFetch splits a download across many connections, resumes where it stopped,
saves HLS streams and videos from web pages, and downloads torrents and magnets
without a second program. A browser extension for Chrome, Edge and Firefox hands
downloads to it. Free and open source; everything runs on this computer.
en-US.name: HyperFetch
